sources.excerpt: --> Mid-Fi Electronics ::: Yard Sale HOME PEDALS PURCHASE Yard Sale Over the years I’ve plugged my guitar into the mic input of pretty much every piece of consumer electronics I’ve come across. A few were total magic and this pedal is a tribute to those.  A little hissy, a little blown out/saggy, fairly low input impedance, and extremely fun to play.  (Cleans up with your instrument’s volume control really well too) Circuit is fully discrete using a pair of Soviet era Silicon transistors.  Controls for: "Mic" (Gain), and overall volume all content © 2026 Doug Tuttle Effects
